visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a Ricoh GR digital camera in the foreground, focusing on a brightly lit circus entrance at night. The background features a large red and yellow striped tent under a banner with 'FOCASA' and lanterns flanking the path. (2) The scene transitions into a montage showing various circus elements: a 'FOCASA' billboard with palm trees nearby, a display of large transparent and solid red spheres in a metal frame, and a child running across a green artificial turf towards a colourful geometric installation. (3) A young boy wearing a surgical mask sits and eats popcorn from a branded 'FOCASA' box; later, a woman leads the child by the hand toward a food stall. A performer in an enormous tiered colorful skirt and a rabbit-themed headpiece interacts with the boy. (4) The scene shifts inside the tent, showing a large audience seated in rows. The boy is seen running through the aisles. Confetti bursts from the ceiling over a group of performers on stage who are bowing and waving to the crowd under intense, colorful spotlights. (5) The video concludes with several wide shots of the circus tent exterior at night, the red balloon floating, and a final static shot of the 'FOCASA' entrance gate with festival flags.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sharp mechanical click of a camera shutter as the Ricoh GR is triggered. Immediately, a warm, melodic acoustic guitar track starts playing a steady folk rhythm. (2) A male singer begins singing in Italian with a gentle and clear tone; the music maintains a consistent tempo with soft piano accompaniment. (3) As the visuals transition to the circus interior, the acoustic texture shifts slightly to include faint reverb consistent with a large indoor tent, accompanied by distant sounds of a crowd murmuring and clapping. (4) During the stage performance scenes, the volume of the crowd applause increases moderately, mixing with the ongoing folk song. (5) The music continues steadily until the end of the video, maintaining its positive and calm emotional valence as the singer finishes a phrase and the instruments slowly fade out.
